plate.viewWhy: Census view is side; bench placement under the bar, the mid-chest touch point, the stop height and the back arch all read in the sagittal plane (c2, c3, c4, c7).
plate.equipment: Smith machine (rails, bar, hooks; the bar runs in a straight path, c8) with a flat bench placed so the bar lines up with the mid-chest (c2); safety stops at the bottom of the bar's travel (c4); feet flat on the floor (c2).
plate.start: Lying face up, shoulder blades together, chest up (c1), feet flat (c2); bar unhooked and held on straight arms over the mid-chest (c2, c5).
plate.end: Bar lowered with control until it touches the mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the body (c3); back not excessively arched (c7).
